title: 3 Ashgrove, Carlanstown, Kells, Co. Meath, A82XD30
seoTitle: 3 Ashgrove, Carlanstown, Kells, Co. Meath, A82XD30
description:
Lydon Farrell Property are delighted to present this well designed large 4 bedroom detached family home which has great character and good specification. 3 Ashgrove is situated within the village centre and only walking distance to an abundance of amenities including local shops, a school, good public transport and Carlanstown is only 6 minutes from the M3 Motorway. The Ashgrove estate is positioned off the Main Street within a small estate of only 5 houses.

The accommodation compromises of a large impressive entrance hall, a bright living room to the front and then there is an open plan dining area with a kitchen to the rear. Also included on the ground floor is a launrdry / utility and a separate bathroom.  The ground floor is generally open plan which in turn allows a lot of natural light from the bright landscaped back garden. 

The first floor compromises of 4 spacious bedrooms including a master ensuite with built in wardrobes and a family bathroom. The property has a large beautifully maintained enclosed garden to the rear. The garden features a patio area and raised flower beds.

Carlanstown is only 5 minutes from Kells town centre, 6 minutes from the M3 Motorway, 20 minutes from Navan town centre and 40 minutes from Blanchardstown. The property is also within proximity of a good bus service which operates frequently into Dublin City Centre, Kells and to Dundalk. Carlanstown truly offers a strong community culture and a better way of living with one able to enjoy living within the peaceful and scenic countryside surroundings.

Viewings by appointment.
